Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The Custom Bid is floated as Open Tender Enquiry (OTE) through GeM Portal for the item “HOT FORMED HOLLOW STEEL SQUARE PIPE AS PER IS:4923 GRADE Yst 310 TO SIZE: 25 X 25 X 2.6 MM THICK LENGTH 6 METER” for 98912 Kg. Quantity Tolerance: +/- 5% applicable. Reverse Auction: Applicable with H1 elimination. Bid Distribution Criteria: L1 : L2 : L3 :: 50% : 30% : 20% Option Clause: 25% Applicable EMD: Rs. 243354/- or Bid security Declaration PSD: 5% applicable for above Rs. 10 Lakhs S.O. Value. Inspection Authority: ED/OFDC or his authorized representative Inspection Type: Inspection at Buyer’s premises. Documents required from Firm: GST, MSME, Udyam Aadhaar, Past Performance etc. Integrity Pact: Firms have to submit integrity pact (attached in Bid Specific ATC document) duly signed on all pages and mentioning Bid Number. Delivery Period : 90 Days Supply Schedule : (1) Minimum 40% qty. within 30 days from S.O. date, next 30% qty. within 60 days and balance qty. within Delivery Period. Firm should strictly follow the delivery schedule. (2) Firm to submit material test certificate from NABL approved laboratory at the time of Inspection and Supply. (3) Firm should submit undertaking along with bid for acceptance of above delivery schedule, otherwise bidder may be disqualified at the time of TEC. (4) Bulk qty. to be supplied at OFDC premises and bulk to be inspected at OFDC premises. (5) Firm should note that to maintain OFDC supply schedule to consignee factory, the above item should be available to OFDC production section as per the above mentioned schedule. Therefore, OFDC reserves the right to reduce or even cancel S.O. Qty., if firm fails to adhere to the supply schedule. Past Performance Criteria:

Firm must have supplied any type of hollow pipes / tubes within last 05 year value not less than 35 Lakhs cumulatively to OF’s / Govt. Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. Otherwise Firm’s offer is not acceptable. Other Terms & Conditions: As per YILPM’2024 Bank Guarantee Format for PBG and EMD is uploaded herewith. For any inquiry please contact Sri Akash Verma, Deputy General Manager, for Executive Director, OFDC, Phn. No. 033-2569-4012. Bidder can also email at OFDC email id. mmofdc@ord.gov.in . 11.
